Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
Snapshot of the dayIn your role as Industrial Cybersecurity Expert for Critical Infrastructure, you will become a true professional in thinking outside the box. To better protect our IT and OT systems, you will explore all possible ways to deceive, bypass, and strengthen them effectively. You will ask questions that have no answers yet and look for gaps where hardly anyone suspects them. Your work will directly contribute to improving our project execution and meeting market requirements. You will work closely with various teams to implement new security features and optimize existing systems. Embedded in a team of cybersecurity experts you have the chance to see cybersecurity from different angles and continuously exchange with and learn from colleagues around the world. Your contribution will help to improve the resilience of critical infrastructure to face the challenges of todays world.How Youll Make an ImpactAnalyzing cybersecurity requirements derived from applicable regulations, industry standards, and customer specifications, translating them into actionable measures and ensuring their fulfillment through comprehensive traceability.Supporting the definition, alignment and implementation of a holistic cybersecurity requirements engineering framework.Providing guidance and training to various departments to support the effective implementation of cybersecurity requirements engineering.Leading cybersecurity process implementation initiatives and foster organizational awareness through training and knowledge sharing.Supporting regulatory and standards compliance by implementing cybersecurity requirements in line with IEC 62443, NERC CIP, EU Data Act, CRA, and other relevant frameworks.What You BringUniversity degree in IT Security, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electronics, Electrical Engineering with focus on IT Security or a comparable qualification with extensive professional experience in OT or product security.Basic security certifications such as GIAC GSEC or similar.Knowledge of relevant cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., ISA/IEC 62443, CRA, NERC CIP, BDEW Whitepaper, ISO27001 is a plus).Knowledge of digital certificates (X.509) and system hardening techniques.Experience with firewalls, certificates, intrusion detection systems, TLS/SSL, 802.1X.Basic skills in testing tools like Kali Linux, Nessus, Wireshark.
